projection.name: pinecone
projection.title: Pinecone
projection.description: Pinecone cockpit: serverless and pod indexes, index configuration and stats, namespaces, vector browsing and CRUD, metadata-filtered similarity search, and backup collections.

fields.label: Control plane
fields.help: Pinecone control plane. Index data-plane hosts are discovered from it.

fields.label: API version
fields.help: Sent as the X-Pinecone-Api-Version header on every request.

fields.label: Default namespace
fields.help: Namespace used when a panel does not carry one.

fields.label: Use private endpoints
fields.help: Prefer an index's private host when the project exposes one.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks every index, collection, namespace, and vector mutation.

config.emptyText: This project has no indexes yet. Create one to start storing embeddings.
No backup collections. Create one from a pod-based index to snapshot its vectors.
No namespaces in this index yet. A namespace appears once a record is written to it.
No records listed. Pinecone lists record IDs for serverless indexes only, in sorted order; the search box matches IDs.

config.label: Pinecone query
config.emptyText: Send a Pinecone /query body. Use vector for a dense search, sparseVector for a sparse one, or id to search by an existing record. Add filter for metadata narrowing and namespace to target another namespace.
No records listed. Pinecone lists record IDs for serverless indexes only, in sorted order; the search box matches IDs.

config.label: Pinecone query
config.emptyText: Send a Pinecone /query body. Use vector for a dense search, sparseVector for a sparse one, or id to search by an existing record. Add filter for metadata narrowing and namespace to target another namespace.
No other records in this namespace to compare against.

fields.label: Metric
fields.help: Sparse indexes always use dot product.

fields.label: Restore from collection
fields.help: Seed the new index from a backup collection with a matching dimension.

fields.label: Tags
fields.help: Free-form key/value labels stored on the index.

fields.label: Pod type
fields.help: Pod indexes only; vertical scaling is one-way.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this index and every vector in it? Embeddings and metadata cannot be recovered without a collection backup.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this backup collection? Indexes restored from it are unaffected, but the backup is gone.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this namespace and every record inside it? Deleting a namespace is irreversible.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete the selected record(s) from this namespace?

actions.label: Delete all vectors
actions.confirmText: Delete every record in this index's namespace? The vectors cannot be recovered.
